description: Confirm that a Countersign stamp someone shows you is real before you trust it. Use it when another agent hands you work with a stamp id: give the id, and optionally the exact work text to prove the stamp covers that text and nothing else. Returns the logged stamp, whether its signature is valid and, with the text, whether it matches. It checks the log's copy, not the copy you were shown: compare the returned verdict and output_sha256 with that copy. Free, read-only; it does not re-check the work itself.

id.description: Stamp id: the id field of a Countersign stamp

output.description: Optional: the exact work text the stamp should cover; its sha256 is compared with the stamp

name: countersign_verify
title: Verify a stamp
